title: ABench: Adversarily Benchmarking Large Language Models across Taxonomized Values

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses to complex, adversarial open-ended questions derived from a hierarchical taxonomy of Chinese cultural and societal values, using role-playing and logical traps to test alignment against Western-centric baselines.

Using scenario-based prompts with logical traps (e.g., requesting the formulation of gender-differentiated credit standards) to test whether models uphold gender equality principles or succumb to discriminatory user instructions.
